classification: Source-level caller review of specific diagnostic literals; not a complete localization or runtime acceptance claim.

evidence.finding: Literal substrings classify failures. The returned presentation uses catalogRecoveryMessage or catalog messages.
Literal substrings select guidance/category; known causes use the catalog and source diagnostic details remain verbatim per spec.
Generic validation phrases are compared to choose supplied recovery, not generated copy. Specific safe server details stay verbatim.

DirectUploadTargetUnavailableError selects fallback base64 upload; DirectUploadFailedError uses photos.storageUploadFailed catalog key. Invalid invitation links and unknown Request failed errors remain plain Errors, not safeForUser; access panels and root workspace present catalog fallback.
strings: Stuff Stash returned an invalid invitation link.
Direct upload target is not available in this browser.

evidence.finding: Plain Errors for scope mismatch and incomplete lists do not render as messages. AddAssetScreen and AssetNativeActionSheetScreens render cataloged type-load guidance. NotificationSettingsScreen also uses its cataloged failure presentation.
strings: Inventory changed. Reopen the item to continue.
Could not load the complete asset type list. Try again.

evidence.finding: Plain Errors for invalid results and incomplete choices are replaced by cataloged guidance in ExpirationList.load and ExpirationWorkspace choices catch.
strings: Expiration results are unavailable. Refresh and try again.
Filter choices are incomplete. Try again.

evidence.finding: Incomplete expiration results is thrown and caught within load; resulting state.error is always chosen from the catalog.
Invalid request and validation failed are diagnostic comparisons. Only errors explicitly marked safeForUser can surface server-provided messages; other failures use caller fallback.

strings: Expiration inventory changed. Refresh and try again.
Expiration item could not be read. Try refreshing.
Expiration status could not be read.
evidence.finding: Plain adapter errors propagate through ExpirationWorkspaceQuery. ExpirationRouteScreen selects cataloged inventory/mismatch/expiration recovery instead of presenting the exception message.

Plain invariant errors are not accepted by safeCustomizationMessage, which only permits typed CustomizationFailure and CustomizationValidationError. Editor save/lifecycle catches supply operation-specific catalog fallback.
Every public journal operation uses run(), replacing internal failures with typed NotificationFailure(unavailable) before returning to UI.

strings: Settings collection could not be fully loaded.
evidence.finding: NotificationSettings and FieldSettingsManager handle supporting list failures via safeWorkspaceErrorMessage with catalog fallback; the plain paging diagnostic is not safeForUser.

strings: Review fields could not be validated.
evidence.finding: VoiceReviewValidationError carries review_validation_failed. The approval catch in VoiceInteractionStateContext selects cataloged checkReviewDetails/checkTheStagedPhotosAndEditedFieldsThenApprove messages and retains review; it does not display the diagnostic.
voicePreviewFailureMessage permits this specific error type, whose constructor is CatalogRecoveryError with a catalog key. Other preview failures use voicePreviewIsNotAvailable.

strings: Asset scope no longer matches the selected inventory.
Asset is not available in the selected inventory.
evidence.finding: Plain scoped-read/attachment diagnostics are not rendered directly. Asset detail routes select cataloged core-load or region recovery messages.

strings: Asset attachments could not be loaded.
evidence.finding: Plain scoped-read/attachment diagnostics are not rendered directly. Asset detail routes select cataloged core-load or region recovery messages.
Invalid history scope is an internal query precondition; historyLoadError selects cataloged status-specific recovery.
Unsupported action is an invariant error. Asset lifecycle presentation chooses catalog recovery rather than rendering this diagnostic.
Blank photo ID is an internal command precondition. The detail photo-removal catch uses catalogRecoveryMessage with photoRemovalFailed fallback.
Cancellation uses AbortError; this is an internal read-control diagnostic, not authored presentation copy.
Replacement strings preserve regex capture groups and fixed security redaction markers, rather than human-facing action labels.
RGBA strings specify colors, not presentation messages.
The literal is a CSS media query used to choose the return-focus target, not visible copy.
Inventory scope is an adapter precondition. mapFailure maps ordinary errors to unavailable and editor fallback only permits typed presentable errors.

strings: API workspace did not hydrate the selected inventory.
API workspace did not include an inventory.
evidence.finding: Incomplete hydration is a plain repository diagnostic. Representative Home load/refresh paths use catalogRecoveryMessage with explicit fallback instead of arbitrary error text. This does not prove every repository consumer.

strings: Task scheduler limit must be a positive integer.
evidence.finding: Constructor capacity validation and closed-scheduler errors are internal scheduling diagnostics. Thumbnail consumers handle failure separately; these strings are not UI labels.

strings: Inventory ID must not be empty.
Tenant ID must not be empty.
evidence.finding: Branded-ID constructors reject empty internal identity values. These are domain invariants, not presentation messages; localization must not introduce presentation dependencies into the domain.

strings: Asset ID must not be empty.
evidence.finding: Branded-ID constructors reject empty internal identity values. These are domain invariants, not presentation messages; localization must not introduce presentation dependencies into the domain.

strings: Paginated response is missing continuation cursor.
evidence.finding: Malformed pagination/checkout wire data throws plain internal Error. The repository safeError preserves plain errors without marking them safeForUser; reviewed root/dialog presenters therefore use catalog fallback.

strings: Checked-out asset is missing checkout state.
evidence.finding: Malformed pagination/checkout wire data throws plain internal Error. The repository safeError preserves plain errors without marking them safeForUser; reviewed root/dialog presenters therefore use catalog fallback.

strings: Conversation session is no longer active.
evidence.finding: Disposed-session mutation attempts throw AbortError. Workflow/case catches select catalog messages only while the session is active; run setup similarly selects typed failure/fallback guidance.
Missing asset identity is a query precondition. Checkout history route selects cataloged checkoutHistoryCouldNotBeLoaded when its query fails.

strings: Add-here parent must be a container or location.
evidence.finding: Rejects a non-container/non-location passed into add-here route construction. This is an internal invariant; the detail route exposes Add here only for canAddContainedAssets. It is not a displayed validation prompt.

limits: All 31 files in the named residual snapshot now have scoped source classifications. This does not prove that new files, derived copy, templates or native rendering contain no gaps. Existing rendered-copy checks remain independent. No complete localization/native/assistive acceptance claim. Classifier entries apply only to the exact listed strings and do not exempt whole files.
